# LaTeXView

**Class:** `UltraCanvasLaTeXView` · **Group:** [Text, images and media](../Groups/Text-images-and-media.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/LaTeX/UltraCanvasLaTeXView.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/LaTeX/UltraCanvasLaTeXView.h) · `#include "Plugins/LaTeX/UltraCanvasLaTeXView.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

A LaTeX formula (equation, matrix, ...) as an element

## Overview

Abstract LaTeX (math) view. Concrete instances are produced by CreateLaTeXView() once the LaTeX module has been loaded on demand.

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasLaTeXView> CreateLaTeXView( const std::string& identifier = "LaTeXView", float x = 0, float y = 0, float w = 0, float h = 0);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasLaTeXView(const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

| `SetDisplayStyle` | `virtual void SetDisplayStyle(bool display) = 0` | Display style (the default: large operators with limits, full-size fractions, as inside \\[ \\]) or text style (as inside $ $, for a formula that sits in a line of text). Honoured by the native engine. |
